title: Psionic pipeline feeding the UAP legacy program

tellings.quote: I was in a you know psionic development uh pipeline for legacy program development

plain: Jordan Jose says that as a child in Western New York, between 2008 and 2010, he was put through a "psionic development pipeline", a programme to train psychic abilities of the mind, in order to feed what he calls "legacy program development". In this subject, a legacy program means a long-running secret government effort around UAP, the official term for UFOs. Jose tells Michels this as something he lived through, and if it is true, the secret UFO effort was recruiting and training psychic children.
